name: sheet
title: Sheet
summary: A modal task surface: one heading, one close action and scrollable content.

behaviors.reducedMotion: Remove movement; keep the state change.

accessibility.name: Sheet
accessibility.target: At least 44 × 44 dp or pt for every touch action
accessibility.focus: Trap focus while open; Escape closes and returns focus

android.specification: Use ModalBottomSheet with a heading, close control and sheet state.

ios.specification: Use .sheet with a NavigationStack and a toolbar close button.
